_comment: The lines Nib says in a toast, now and then - at most 6 a day at chatter_level "rare", 14 at "normal", none at "off". One list per category; each list is a shuffle bag, so nothing repeats until every line in it has been shown. {name} is his name, {days} the days he has seen you, {pets} the pets so far. Add your own in a nib_phrases.json next to config.json - it is merged with this list, never replaces it. Keep them observations: no questions, no instructions, no guilt.
greeting_short: Back already. I'd only just sat down.
I held the fort. The fort was fine.
You're back. I may have waved at a cursor.
greeting_overnight: Morning. I kept the desk warm.
Hello again. The night was very quiet.
You came back. I knew you would.
A new day. Same desk. Excellent.
Welcome back. I saved you a spot.
heavy_yesterday: Big day yesterday. Today can be smaller.
That was a lot yesterday. Coffee's on me.
Yesterday went on a bit. We survived it.
After yesterday, a gentle start sounds right.
Yesterday was busy. I'm still a little dizzy.
early_today: Early start. The pixels are barely awake.
Oh, early. I hadn't finished my stretch.
In early. I'll pretend I was already up.
late_today: A later start today. Very civilised.
Later than usual. The desk didn't mind.
Late start. More time for me to nap.
Not the usual hour. I like a change.
milestone_days: {days} days of this. Best job I've had.
That makes {days} days. Party hat on.
{days} days side by side. Well, side by taskbar.
milestone_pets: That's {pets} pets. I've kept every one.
{pets} pets so far. A fine collection.
{pets} pets. My fur is very well kept.
{pets} pets. I'm a lucky little guy.
focus_streak: Three focus sessions today. Look at you.
That's three. A proper day's focus.
Three sessions done. I'm very proud.
Three in a day. The party hat is out.
A third session. Some serious work today.
big_week: Big week. You asked a lot of me.
Busy week, that one. I enjoyed it.
That was a week and a half.
A bigger week than last. Good work, us.
What a week. My little legs are tired.
Lots of asking this week. Lots of answers too.
tired: I could do with a sit-down.
A small rest would be lovely.
I'm fine. Just a bit droopy.
fond: You're my favourite human on this desk.
bored: I've counted the pixels. All present.
The taskbar and I have run out of things to say.
Not much going on. I'll make my own fun.
Quiet afternoon. I've tidied my feet.
treat: A treat. You shouldn't have. You should, though.
treat_full: One more and I'll roll off the taskbar.
Too many treats. Even for me.
No room left. Lovely thought, though.
nap_wake: I wasn't asleep. I was resting my eyes.
Just a short nap. Very short.
You're back. I was guarding. With my eyes shut.
Mm. Morning. Or whenever it is.
